listen_port.description: TCP port on which comsatd listens for incoming mail notifications.

bind_host.description: Network address to bind the service to (IPv4 or IPv6).

enabled.description: Whether the comsatd service is active.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

exec_cmd.description: Shell command template to invoke when new mail arrives. '%s' is replaced with the recipient username.

allowed_senders.description: List of permitted sender domains (e.g., ['example.com', 'myorg.org']). Leave empty to accept mail from any sender.

user_overrides.description: Per-user command overrides. Each entry specifies a user and a custom exec_cmd for them.

user.description: Username for which to override the command.

exec_cmd.description: Custom command template for this user.

log_file.description: Path to the service log file.
